name: zusage-marketplace
description: zcode-token-usage-statusbar 插件市场（clean 分叉）：ZCode token 用量查询（MCP / 命令 / 技能）与桌面悬浮状态条（仅经 /install-overlay 显式安装；hook 零上下文注入；自动更新/引擎补丁缺省关闭）。

plugins.name: zcode-token-usage-statusbar
plugins.description: ZCode token 用量查询（token_usage MCP 工具 + /usage 命令 + 技能，读本地 usage 数据库）；clean 分叉：不自动安装状态条（仅 /install-overlay 显式触发，修改 app.asar，成功后需完全退出并重开）；hook 任何路径都无条件不向模型上下文注入文字（速率背景行注入已彻底移除，answer_rate_line 只控制前端统计行）；后台自动更新缺省关（config plugin_auto_update:true 显式开启）；自动压缩阈值引擎补丁缺省关（config auto_compact_patch:true 显式开启）；macOS 待更新包预注入缺省关（config pending_zip_patch:true 显式开启，仅 macOS 生效）；本机 CDP 调试口（127.0.0.1:9229）缺省关（config cdp_debug_port:true 显式开启，仅本机回环）；卸载时还原全部客户端修改（含引擎补丁）。回答末尾逐问速率行由前端确定性渲染，依赖 renderer 桥。

description_i18n.en: ZCode token usage query via the token_usage MCP tool, /usage command, and skill (reads the local usage DB). Clean fork: no auto-install of the desktop status bar (explicit /install-overlay only; modifies app.asar - fully quit and reopen ZCode to take effect); hooks never inject text into the model context under any condition (the per-prompt rate background-line injection is removed entirely; answer_rate_line only toggles the deterministic UI stats line); background auto-update defaults off (opt-in via plugin_auto_update:true); auto-compact engine patch defaults off (opt-in via auto_compact_patch:true); macOS pending-update-zip pre-patch defaults off (opt-in via pending_zip_patch:true, macOS only); the local CDP debug port (127.0.0.1:9229) defaults off (opt-in via cdp_debug_port:true, loopback only); uninstall restores every client modification including the engine patch.
